name: cand_fitb_3db
setup: for g in MALE FEMALE; do ln -sf SMPLX_NEUTRAL.npz /workspace/HeadMovement/mamma/data/body_models/smplx_locked_head/smplx/SMPLX_$g.npz; done; nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total --format=csv

commands.name: fit_3db_parallel
commands.cmd: mkdir -p /workspace/HeadMovement/dancecap/work/larissa_kadu_38_mono06/mamma/logs; for t in 3db_w05 3db 3db_w8; do (python -m dancecap mamma fit larissa_kadu_38_mono06 --tag $t > /workspace/HeadMovement/dancecap/work/larissa_kadu_38_mono06/mamma/logs/fit_$t.out 2>&1; echo $? > /workspace/HeadMovement/dancecap/work/larissa_kadu_38_mono06/mamma/logs/fit_$t.rc) & sleep 20; done; wait; bad=0; for t in 3db_w05 3db 3db_w8; do rc=$(cat /workspace/HeadMovement/dancecap/work/larissa_kadu_38_mono06/mamma/logs/fit_$t.rc 2>/dev/null); echo "[3db] fit $t rc=$rc"; tail -n 4 /workspace/HeadMovement/dancecap/work/larissa_kadu_38_mono06/mamma/logs/fit_$t.out; [ "$rc" = 0 ] || bad=1; done; exit $bad

notes: mono4d fit B + SAM 3D Body prior: MAMMA_MONO=1 single-camera ma_3d of phone 06, 58-62 s, with pose_prior_loss (mamma-turing utils/mono.py, MAMMA_POSE_PRIOR) at weights 3db_w05=0.5, 3db=2, 3db_w8=8; '3db' is pre-registered
the prior: SAM 3D Body's own per-frame SMPL-X (candidate sam3d_body) moved to the world with phone 06's track; no multi-view data enters except the camera track and sync, exactly as for fit B
3db_smoke: 2 iterations a stage, a crash check before the three 15-min fits
